body: Override _compute_memo_tag on MemoComponent to skip the self.tag segment, which is already embedded in the dynamic subclass __qualname__ (MemoComponent_). Previously the wrapper tag contained the inner tag twice (e.g. Memocomponent_card_98ffd1e1_card_98ffd1e1_). Adds a regression test asserting the inner tag appears exactly once.
